summary: Lists bundled PowerShell utils (ArgvParser, CamelConversion, CommandUtil, FileUtil, Legacy, LinkUtil, SID) and explains custom PowerShell and C# utils go in a module_utils folder in the playbook or role, with C# files named Ansible.<namespace>.cs.
questions: Which PowerShell util runs a process and captures stdout and rc?
Is there a util to convert camelCase keys to snake_case?
Where do I put custom PowerShell module utils for my role?
How must custom C# module util files be named?

answer_card.title: Bundled and custom PowerShell utils
answer_card.answer_md:
Bundled: `ArgvParser` (escape args), `CamelConversion` (camelCase → snake_case), `CommandUtil` (run process, get stdout/stderr/rc), `FileUtil` (special files like pagefile), `Legacy` (general helpers), `LinkUtil` (symlinks/junctions/hard links), `SID` (name ↔ SID).

Custom utils go in `module_utils/` at the playbook or role root. C# files must end in `.cs`, start with `Ansible.` and match the namespace.
